# My Top Countries

> A personal travel blog chronicling adventures across 76+ countries.

## Overview

This website documents personal travel experiences, top country rankings, and insights from visiting over 76 countries. It serves as a travel diary and a source of inspiration for fellow travelers.

## Site Structure

- [Home](https://mytopcountries.web.app/): Introduction to the travel blog, featuring a highlight video and quick links.
- [Blog](https://mytopcountries.web.app/blog): Detailed posts about specific trips, travel tips, and destination reviews.
- [Top Countries](https://mytopcountries.web.app/blog/top-countries): A curated list of the top 10 favorite countries visited, with flags and statistics.
- [Countries](https://mytopcountries.web.app/countries): A comprehensive list and tracker of all countries visited.
- [About](https://mytopcountries.web.app/about): Information about the author, their background, and travel philosophy.

## Key Content

- **Travel Statistics**: Tracks the number of countries visited (currently 76).
- **Destinations**: Features content on Australia, Greece, Morocco, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Portugal, Thailand, Peru, USA, Mexico, and more.
- **Tools**: Includes a "World Population (live)" tracker.

## Technical Details

- Built with **Astro** and **Tailwind CSS**.
- Deployment: `https://mytopcountries.web.app/`
